# Email for notification type budget_threshold (notifications.TypeBudgetThreshold): refactor plan step S10.
# Regenerate (a deliberate, release-noted behavior change only):
#   UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test ./internal/notify -count=1 -run '^TestNotificationContent$'
# Emailed by default (OPENV_EMAIL_NOTIFICATION_TYPES unset): yes. The override run sets it to exactly the
# types the defaults leave out. Each message is the SMTP hand-off of the real mailer;
# every line ends CRLF on the wire (a bare LF would show as ␊, a bare CR as ␍).

======== agentrun.finished takes the month's spend past 80% of the budget | delivery 1 of 2 | to user-ada
with the default allow-list: sent; with the override: not sent
envelope: smtp.example.test:587, MAIL FROM openv@example.test, RCPT TO ada@example.test, no auth
-------- message
From: openv@example.test
To: ada@example.test
Subject: Workspace reached 80% of its budget
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8

Workspace reached 80% of its budget

This month's agent runs have spent $212.50 of the $250.00 budget.

Open it in OpenV:
https://openv.example.test/org/settings?tab=usage

—
You are receiving this because email notifications are enabled for your OpenV account. Turn them off in Settings → Notifications.
-------- end
